title: Galveston Sightseeing Tour 5-Hr private day trip
includes: Professional guide/certified Tourism Ambassador for Galveston, Texas
Hotel pickup and drop-off (INSIDE CENTRAL HOUSTON ONLY)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Collapsible, non-motorized wheelchairs can be accommodated. Occupant must be able to board and disembark the vehicle without assistance from the driver.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The perfect way to explore Galveston Island in comfort and style! Our air-conditioned sightseeing tours offer a seamless blend of scenic beauty and professional service, ideal for visiting from Houston. Whether you're soaking in coastal charm or uncovering historic landmarks, every moment is crafted for relaxation and enjoyment. Galveston is 50 mi/ 80 km from downtown Houston. 1-hr scenic road views each way. Hear island history from cannibals and pirates to gangsters and presidents. 90-min island sightseeing to include Early Victorian Mansions, Moody Gardens Pyramids, Ocean Views, Bay Area, Beach Area, Cruise port, Fort Crockett, The Pleasure Pier, The Sacred Heart Cathedral, The Bishop's Palace. 2-hrs travel, 90 min sightseeing, 90 min self-guided free time.

 This customized tour allows the option to skip sightseeing for direct drop off at ocean view dining, cocktail bars, beaches, shopping, museums & attractions. Additional time can be added to this experience.
